messages:
sophie_cs: FYI customer ACME (org: acme-49) reports their org-level latency dashboard has no p95/p99 lines after last night's deploy. Screenshot attached. They say per-route panels still show values but tenant view is blank. @eng-sre please triage.
matt_sre: Thanks Sophie — can you paste the org id (copied) and the exact time they noticed it?
sophie_cs: org id acme-49. They noticed at ~02:20 UTC this morning. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/acme-49-pctiles.png
arjun_platform: tagging in telemetry team. We had a tag-remap change rolled to canary last night that renames "service" -> "svc_name" for downstream grouping. That could break percentile grouping if the dashboard still queries by the old label.
matt_sre: Noted. I'm hitting the metrics API for raw percentile series now:
```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?org=acme-49&metric=latency_p95&range=24h" | jq '.data'
```
-> empty array returned for p95/p99 series at org scope. Per-route queries (with svc_name=...) return results.
elena_support: Customer also attached the console response: "No percentile series found for org-level aggregation". They tried time range last 24h and last 7d, same result.
deploy-bot: telemetry-canary rollout completed @ 2025-11-12T02:12:08Z
matt_sre: timeline looks like: canary roll at 02:12, first missing reports 02:20, metrics-collector logs show a surge of 400s for org-aggregation writes between 02:13-02:16. Suspect the remap caused aggregation key mismatch and the aggregator rejected some writes.
arjun_platform: If the aggregator changed expected label keys, the tenant-level rollup job might have written under the new key (svc_name) while dashboard queries still look for series grouped by service. Two fixes: 1) add compatibility remapping on query path, 2) roll back the tag-remap in telemetry canary.
matt_sre: Quick repro steps I ran locally:
1) query per-route: `metric=latency_p95{svc_name="payments"}` -> returns series
2) query org-level: `metric=latency_p95{org="acme-49"}` -> empty
3) inspect collector logs: `kubectl logs metrics-collector-... | grep acme-49 | grep "rejected key"`
I'll open a pager duty incident if we see customer impact across tenants.
sophie_cs: Customer asking for ETA and if there's a workaround. They can't use the org-level SLO view for nightly reporting.
arjun_platform: Mitigation plan: re-enable compatibility label mapping on aggregator (1hr) or roll back the tag-remap canary to previous known-good (15-30m) if we want fastest customer recovery. I'll prepare a rollback PR now.
matt_sre: I'm going to run a narrow reindex for acme-49 to populate missing aggregated series as a stopgap (could take ~30-90m depending on history). If rollback chosen, reindex not needed. ETA to Sophie: initial mitigation decision in 10-15m.
elena_support: Passing to customer. Please keep timeline updates here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sophie_cs: thanks — will tell them we're working on a rollback option and will update in 15m.
matt_sre: Update: collector logs indicate ~2.1k rejected aggregation writes for acme-49. Reindex queued. arjun, any update on rollback PR?
arjun_platform: PR open and approved, triggering rollback to previous telemetry image now. I'll post diff and rollout timeline once k8s jobs start.
deploy-bot: rollback deployment started for telemetry-canary at 2025-11-12T02:45:12Z
matt_sre: After rollback started I'm seeing org-level p95 series reappear in a small sample (acme-49) at 02:50 UTC. Still monitoring. If reindex completes it will fill history.
sophie_cs: passing good news to customer, they'll verify dashboards.
elena_support: customer confirms p95/p99 visible again in org dashboard. They appreciate quick response. Closing on their side but keeping thread open until reindex finishes to ensure historical data backfilled.
matt_sre: Leaving follow-ups: (1) add automated compatibility layer for label renames, (2) add smoke test that checks tenant-level percentile series after any telemetry change, (3) alert rule on rejected-aggregation-writes > 100/min.
arjun_platform: Agreed. I'll add the smoke check to the telemetry CI and follow up with a postmortem doc link once we have notes.
sophie_cs: thanks all. I'll mark customer updated and schedule a proactive note for other tenants."
